scope: Exactly two fresh-session diagnostic replays with experimental in-process planner SYSTEM append. Same provider models, settings, verification and recovery. No production source edits; no reruns. Not a benchmark.
added_text: Every response must use the supplied tools. When ready to answer, write the complete draft exactly once inside submit_answer; do not first write it as a prose response. Use submit_answer for clarifications and insufficient-evidence responses too.

cases.question: How do I trace a custom multi-turn agent in Python?
How do I evaluate my agent using a dataset and an LLM judge?

acceptance: Both planner loops avoid prose-only drafts.
Both deliver supported useful answers of the same quality against original UI manual criteria.
Both improve elapsed time relative to corresponding UI-v2 receipt.
limits: Two unpaired diagnostic replays; changed prompt and variable provider load/cache state mean no reliable speedup estimate.
Returned-token estimate cap is not account billing cap; excludes Signals and unreturned charges.
